findings.rationale: Domain, range-type, and leadsTo binder bounds are accepted without checking lo <= hi. An inverted bound therefore becomes an empty domain; bounded actions or leadsTo instances disappear and safety/liveness results can pass vacuously instead of rejecting the malformed model.

Unlike actions and state variables, property names are never deduplicated. Duplicate declarations—and an explicit transition colliding with an until-generated name such as `<name>_until_safety`—share the same name-based origin and annotation target, making results and requirement traceability ambiguous.

Struct construction resolves fields without checking field-name uniqueness. The accepted duplicate names are later collected into a BTreeMap when defaults are created, silently overwriting one declaration and producing a runtime value inconsistent with the declared field vector.

Division and remainder check only for a zero divisor before calling div_euclid/rem_euclid. The valid parsed operands i64::MIN and -1 overflow and panic, so public model-building paths can terminate the process instead of returning ModelError as their contract promises.
